_comment: Litigation-risk scoring weights. Edit these values to retune the model without touching code. All weights are additive points toward a 0-100 score. See tools/_scorer.py for factor logic.

designation._comment: Points for the OMB high-impact designation of a use case.

affects_individuals._comment: Added when the topic area or rights/safety fields indicate direct impact on individuals' rights or benefits.
trigger_topics: Government Services (includes Benefits and Service Delivery)

development_stage._comment: Points for how far along the use case is — deployed systems carry more risk.

has_pii._comment: Points when the use case involves PII.

missing_safeguards._comment: Points per missing safeguard on HIGH_IMPACT or PRESUMED_NOT_HIGH_IMPACT cases. Cap applied separately.

waiver._comment: Points when the agency requested a waiver/extension from minimum risk management practices.

external_evidence._comment: Points from data/known_issues.json (Phase 4). Not used in Phase 2.

bands._comment: Score ranges map to named risk bands.

disclaimer: Indicator for triage only, based on agency self-reported data. Not legal advice.
